name: Critical Management Skills
description: This course was formerly titled ‘Critical management studies’. On the one hand, the name has been changed to reflect a shift in focus lay a foundation of core skills required for your professional life. On the other hand, the course will retain its critical perspective on management theory and practice. In other words, the word ‘critical’ in the title is two-fold: critical in the sense of something important or significant and critical in the sense of having a healthy skepticism towards the messages promoted by organizations regarding workplace behavior
